title: Maryland National Guard Swift Water Rescue
description: The Maryland Army National Guard and the Maryland Helicopter Aquatic Rescue Team conducted swift water rescue training July 29, 2015, at Essex Skypark, Essex Md. The HART training is performed quarterly, and prepares responders for emergency situations such as hurricanes and floods. Also available in high definition.
